name: AutoShorts · Video Factory
summary: Local storyboard, reviewed continuity references/keyframes, native sound with optional narration, RelayVSR and subtitled FFmpeg exports.
notes: Native pipeline: use /api/autoshorts or the autoshorts MCP tool and read capabilities for schemas. Cinema uses board.visualBible and per-scene continuity, reviewed canonical images (references task), keyframe and approve-keyframe tasks before media generation. Dialogue is native character speech; narration is optional TTS. keepAudio:false explicitly mutes native sound; speechMode:mute mutes both. Render writes provenance.json with actual source paths, hashes, factors and audio inputs. Existing engines use the shared queue/history/runner. No single ComfyUI workflow; references reduce drift but do not guarantee consistency.
